name: Coretex SEO
author: Coretex

sections.description:
Coretex SEO is a modern all-in-one SEO plugin for WordPress that combines traditional SEO best practices with AI-assisted analysis and optimization.

Designed for bloggers, businesses, agencies, and developers, Coretex SEO helps improve search visibility by analyzing your website, generating recommendations, and providing intelligent workflows that always keep the final decision in your hands.

Whether you’re optimizing a single page or an entire website, Coretex SEO provides practical tools to improve rankings, content quality, metadata, structured data, and overall SEO performance.

Features

  • AI-powered SEO analysis
  • Intelligent content optimization recommendations
  • Meta title and meta description management
  • XML sitemap generation
  • Schema markup support
  • SEO auditing and reporting
  • Keyword research integrations
  • Search visibility monitoring
  • Human approval workflow before applying AI suggestions
  • Multiple AI provider support
  • Local AI support through Ollama
  • Lightweight and WordPress-native interface

External services

Coretex SEO connects to external services only when an administrator explicitly enables and configures them.

Requests are made only when features such as SEO scans, AI content generation, provider connection tests, keyword research, report generation, or scheduled scans are initiated by the administrator.

OpenAI

Used for AI-assisted SEO analysis and content generation.

Data transmitted may include prompts, page content, metadata, selected model name, and administrator-provided API credentials.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the coretex-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open Coretex SEO from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your preferred AI provider or local Ollama endpoint.
  5. Run your first SEO scan and review the recommendations.
sections.faq:
Is Coretex SEO free?

Yes. Coretex SEO includes a comprehensive set of free SEO features for WordPress.

Does Coretex SEO generate XML sitemaps?

Yes. XML sitemaps can be generated automatically to help search engines discover your website content.

Does it support schema markup?

Yes. Coretex SEO includes structured data support for improved search engine understanding.

Which AI providers are supported?

Coretex SEO supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral AI, Groq, DeepSeek, xAI, Perplexity, OpenRouter, and local Ollama deployments.

Can I use my own local AI model?

Yes. Coretex SEO supports locally hosted AI through Ollama.

Can I use Coretex SEO with another SEO plugin?

For best compatibility and results, only one SEO plugin should be active at any given time.
